items.title: K-flatness is two out of three for a short exact sequence with flat cokernel terms

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma extends the two out of three property for K-flatness to a short exact sequence of complexes whose third complex has flat terms (statement lines 3096-3103). The proof replaces the distinguished triangle of the companion lemma by a short exact sequence: flatness of the terms of K_3^bullet is what makes the sequence of total tensor products short exact for every test complex L^bullet (proof lines 3106-3114), after which acyclicity propagates two out of three through the long exact cohomology sequence and K-flatness follows by quantifying over L^bullet (proof lines 3115-3116). The non-formal content is the identification of the exactness hypothesis with flatness of the terms. The claim is H2: one reduction using a cited flatness criterion.
